branches.definition: The woody part of a tree arising from the trunk and usually dividing.

i.definition: The name of the Latin script letter I/i.

practical.definition: Relating to, or based on, practice or action rather than theory or hypothesis.

problem.definition: A difficulty that has to be resolved or dealt with.

the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
